header: THE RAILWAY CARD, IN THREE TABS: Durgapur Railway Station (DGR), the trains that stop at Durgapur; Asansol Railway Junction (ASN), the trains a person at Durgapur can only have from Asansol (those that pass Durgapur without stopping and those that do not go over it); and the Kolkata stations (HWH, SDAH, SRC, KOAA), the trains that start there and go over neither Durgapur nor Asansol (KolkataPanel.tsx). The Durgapur tab is the card as it was (RailwayCard.tsx); the other two ask for their trains only when first opened, and I keep all as they are while another is shown (a tab that has been opened is hidden, not unmounted, so its switches, the station chosen and the fare boxes that were opened are kept). Arrow keys move between the tabs.
